name: space-quiz
description: Cyberpunk-themed, accessible space exploration quiz in a single HTML file

scripts.validate:w3c: java -jar node_modules/vnu-jar/build/dist/vnu.jar --also-check-svg --Werror --filterpattern ".*Trailing slash on void elements.*" index.html images
scripts.test: npm run lint:html && npm run validate:w3c
